name: US counties: median unemployment rate across counties (causal SA)
source: BLS Local Area Unemployment Statistics (LAUS)
notes: Unweighted across all ~3147 counties with a value that month. Current vintage (files of 2026-09-30); LAUS revises the prior month each release and the previous 5 years each spring (annual benchmark), so values are revised, not first prints. October 2025 was never collected (2025 shutdown) and is missing.
